digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite-verify gate; Bedrock LLM structured-output selection
propositions: Commit 6c8daf7945 added an exact-model-id row setting native_structured_output=True for us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, causing rebar to send Bedrock JSON Schemas for constrained decoding that exceed Anthropic's 180-second grammar-compilation timeout and 24-optional-parameter complexity cap

plan_review_verification (31 optional params) and code_review_verification (36 optional params) both fail with HTTP 400 ValidationException after ~185 seconds when sent as NativeOutput to Bedrock, while the same contracts succeed immediately when sent as PromptedOutput

output_mode() must gate NativeOutput selection on both schema complexity (bound: 16 optional / 12 union parameters, measured inside the 14-pass / 22-fail gap) and runtime stack support for outputConfig parameter, failing closed to PromptedOutput for contracts exceeding either threshold

Schema-complexity and variant-B (botocore-dependent outputConfig rejection) rejections must be classified distinctly from generic provider outages, logged loudly with model and contract names, and trigger a fallback retry on the PromptedOutput path rather than fail the verification step closed
